name: screen-capture
description: Capture and annotate Windows screenshots, then copy them to the clipboard.

interface.shortDescription: Capture, annotate, and copy Windows screenshots.
interface.longDescription: Capture a selected region, the active window, or the full Windows desktop. Region captures open a lightweight annotation toolbar with pen, box, arrow, text, undo, zoom, and copy-to-clipboard support.
defaultPrompt: 截取一个屏幕区域并分析图片。
